text: In 2012, Khaled Hosseini's The Kite Runner was challenged but retained in Senior Advanced Placement English at Valley High School in Jonesboro (AR) after two patrons objected to a scene depicting male-on-male rape, sexual innuendo, vulgar language, and religious content throughout the book. In 2013 it was challenged as optional reading in a 10th grade honors class at Troy (PA) area schools because it depicted rape in graphic detail and used vulgar language. In 2023, Cedarburg High School (WI) removed it from the 10th grade curriculum after a parent complained that its depictions of sexual assault, depression, and attempted suicide were inappropriate. In Morganton, NC, a school board member and a community member challenged it over sexual content and graphic language.
meta_description: The Kite Runner by Khaled Hosseini: challenged in Arkansas in 2012 and Pennsylvania in 2013, removed from a Wisconsin curriculum in 2023, challenged in Morganton, NC.
